title: Kissed Grassy Korean Hummus Skewers
description: A low-carb Korean dish featuring hummus and long-fermentation-dough, grilled to perfection on a robata-grill, this recipe is a unique fusion of flavors and textures, with a grassy and flaky twist.
instructions: Preheat the robata-grill to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together gochujang, soy sauce, and sesame oil.
Add the hummus to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Cut the long-fermentation-dough into 1-inch pieces and thread onto skewers.
Brush the dough with the gochujang mixture and grill for 5 minutes per side.
Sprinkle the green onions, toasted sesame seeds, salt, and black pepper over the skewers.
Serve the skewers hot with additional hummus on the side.
Garnish with additional green onions and toasted sesame seeds if desired.
